item.text: The AMM PA12 material has a solid Young’s modulus of 1,700 MPa. At 23% relative density, the elastic upper bound for E along [100] is 391 MPa, below the requested 587 MPa. This rules out the target within the stated single-solid scope.

arguments.note: For AMM PA12, E_s = 1700 MPa, nu = 0.39. For a periodic void/one-isotropic-solid composite, the uniform-strain variational bound C_eff <= phi C_s implies E100_eff <= phi E_s (allow transverse strains to relax under uniaxial stress). Therefore density <= 0.23 implies E100 <= 0.23*1700 = 391 MPa < 587 MPa. This is a geometry-independent impossibility within the stated scope, not merely an unsuccessful family search. A necessary density for 587 MPa is >= 587/1700 = 0.345294 (34.53%); alternatively the solid modulus must be >= 587/0.23 = 2552.17 MPa. These necessary bounds do not guarantee an attainable design.
